lastCompletedStory.title: Generalize the review-fixture helper and prove codex reviewer resolution

nextStoryContext:
test/supervisor/review.test.ts's withCodexBackendCwd is now withReviewerBackendCwd(backend, model, fn) (module-level, defined right after makeDispatchOpts, before the first describe block) so it's usable by every describe in the file. It stages a temp cwd's scripts/cam/project.toml with `[backend]
reviewer = "<backend>"` plus either a flat `[models]
reviewer = "<model>"` (backend === 'claude') or a nested `[models.<backend>]
reviewer = "<model>"` sub-table (any other backend), plus a stub .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md, with process.chdir restore in finally. The 6 previously real-config-dependent dispatch-shape tests (the CAM-42 interactive-spawn test, the 4 US-005 container-mode dispatch-shape tests AC1/AC3/AC4/CAM-242-diff, and the US-002 'claude backend (default)' assertion) now build their own withReviewerBackendCwd('claude', 'opus', ...) fixture instead of implicitly reading the committed scripts/cam/project.toml (which still resolves 'claude' today, so behavior is unchanged, but the tests no longer silently depend on that fact). A new test ('US-004 (CAM-356): codex reviewer fixture resolves gpt-5.5...') proves withReviewerBackendCwd('codex', 'gpt-5.5', ...) resolves model 'gpt-5.5' (not opus) at the reviewer dispatch site and that codexAuthPreflight's claude-alias guard does NOT abort (authCheckFn is actually invoked, since isClaudeAliasModel('gpt-5.5') === false), then proceeds to respawn-pane once the injected codexAuthCheckFn reports authenticated:true. scripts/cam/project.toml remains byte-unchanged. This closes the CAM-356 epic's test-hygiene follow-up (US-001 backend-aware readPhaseModel/readPhaseBackend, US-002 wired every dispatch site, US-003 made the drift guard tolerant, US-004 decoupled the dispatch-shape tests from the committed config and added positive codex-resolution proof). Raised test/supervisor/review.test.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling 1851->1915 (measured via content.split('
').length, not wc -l) with a dated _ref note; only that file's ceiling was touched.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture refactor (bun:test + node:fs mkdtempSync/writeFileSync/process.chdir, all already-established patterns from the prior CAM-352 story); no new external library API surface was exercised.
